text: Go to Dunkel Valley to find the sweets ingredients for\nFilecia!
Lefina who planned to hinder you from collecting the\ningredients ended up getting crushed underneath the monster\nshe brought with her. Defeat the monster and rescue her!
You could not find the ingredients in the place Filecia told\nyou. Return to El Scaro and confirm the location with her!
